description: [child row - guidance RESYNCED from parent 2026-09-14. The earlier text here was STALE: it described the latch as unfixed, so the drafter re-implemented windowing that had ALREADY LANDED in 38e72ae, producing duplicate symbols and a typecheck refusal. Only the retention third remains.] TWO THIRDS LANDED 2026-09-14; ONE THIRD REMAINS AND IS THE ONLY WORK LEFT HERE. Commit 38e72ae (Substrate Autonomous, 10:06:38Z, on origin/dev) correctly fixed the latch in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/operational-state.ts: the rung's verdict now reads unexaminedInWindow === 0 instead of allTimeUnexamined === 0, so correct behaviour can restore the rung, and the strict zero-tolerance threshold was preserved rather than relaxed - which was the right choice, because relaxing it would reopen the hole through which this substrate once landed a database-breaking migration. VERIFIED: the underlying count is genuinely windowed (the contributing queries are bounded by time::now() - 1d), so this is a real fix and not a rename. WHAT REMAINS: THE ALL-TIME FACT IS NOT ACTUALLY RETAINED, AND THE FIELD THAT CLAIMS TO RETAIN IT IS A TAUTOLOGY. The same commit added staged_unexamined_all_time, computed at line ~258 as allTimeUnexamined = (obs.examUnexamined ?? 0) + (obs.examUnexaminedAllTime ?? 0). But examUnexaminedAllTime is declared (line ~205), read in exactly that one expression, and ONLY EVER ASSIGNED null (line ~779). No code path computes it. Therefore allTimeUnexamined is always equal to examUnexamined, and staged_unexamined_all_time is mathematically identical to staged_unexamined_in_window on every snapshot. THIS IS WORSE THAN OMITTING THE FIELD. A reader comparing the two values to ask 'has this ever happened outside the window?' gets a guaranteed match and concludes it has not. The unwindowed signal - including the event at 2026-09-10T15:34:43 that originally broke the rung - is now unrecoverable from this report while a field named all_time asserts otherwise. Windowing the verdict was correct ONLY on the condition that the all-time fact survived somewhere; that condition is currently unmet. REMEDY: compute examUnexaminedAllTime with the same query as examUnexamined but WITHOUT the time::now() - 1d bound, and have it carry the count of unexamined staged artifacts OLDER than the window (so that windowed + all_time_beyond = true all-time, which is the arithmetic line ~258 already assumes). Do not change the rung verdict; it is correct. Do not relax the zero threshold; it is correct.
